final_result_states.FAIL_rc_1: T_BLOCKING > 0 OR T_FAIL > 0 OR T_HARNESS_ERR > 0 OR CLEANUP_FAILURE > 0
final_result_states.INCOMPLETE_rc_2: No failures, but T_DEFERRED > 0 OR T_UNRESOLVED > 0. Cannot support Checkpoint 0 authorization.
final_result_states.PASS_rc_0: No failures and no mandatory gaps. All items reached.
final_result_states.note: INCOMPLETE is a distinct non-PASS non-FAIL state introduced in R17. It is returned whenever mandatory prerequisites (NEEDS-EXTERNAL) prevent one or more tests from running.
